suites.name: TSS_01
suites.title: V5.53 Final Synthesis
suites.finding: V5.53 COMPLETE; Model B+ (spread-primary, mean-complement predicate); V5.52 mean-centric interpretation refined

modelDescription: SAC P1/P1b assignment is best described by a rawIQR+rawMean rank composite. rawIQR supplies the dominant spread signal (~10x normalized); rawMean stabilizes per-N ambiguity. Diagnostic only, not causal.
researchQuestion: What predicate drives SelectAndClassify P1 vs P1b assignment?
answer: P1/P1b assignment is primarily rawIQR-driven (spread), with rawMean providing independent complementary stabilization. rawIQR dominates ~10x in normalized terms. A rank-based rawIQR+rawMean composite yields consistent P1>P1b direction across all N (2/3 N jackknife-stable). This refines V5.52 by replacing a mean-centric interpretation with a spread-primary predicate model.
supportedFindings: rawIQR is strongest P1/P1b discriminator (10x normalized dominance over rawMean)
P1 preferentially contains higher rawIQR profiles in pooled IsHi-pass population
rawIQR alone not uniformly stable per-N (jackknife 1/3 N)
rawIQR+rawMean rank composite improves per-N stability (2/3 N jackknife-stable)
Composite yields consistent P1>P1b direction across all tested N
V5.52 mean-only interpretation is incomplete; SAC predicate is spread-primary
Stop-Low remains safe across all suites
hypotheses: rawIQR may encode dominant SAC/P1 spread discriminator
rawMean may stabilize rawIQR ambiguity across N
SAC may operate on profile-shape descriptors
A hidden discriminator may remain beyond rawIQR+rawMean
notClaimed: physical N-boundary or physical interpretation of N
new model variables or correction classes
physical length, c, GR, spacetime, or cosmology derivation
